s02141.summary: Maren rations water to a nameless boy in the drifting balloon.
The burner coughs as fuel runs low; Maren spots the boy's medal reading Amadi.
Maren names him Amadi; he admits shouting brought no one, and she hands him the water.
The wind turns the basket toward black smoke, then the flame dies.

s00094.summary: Amara and Theo tend the rooftop hives, teasing as he lights the smoker.
Grandmother Nneka arrives with plantains, sets the bag on a hive, and invites Theo to eat.

s00518.summary: Imani rides the funicular alone, gazing at the city lights.
Ignatius, her ex, boards and they trade awkward words over hot chestnuts.
He mentions her postcards; Imani admits she left a note because she was scared.
A power cut stalls the car; they are left together as city lights flicker.

s01678.summary: The deep-sea lab shudders and Vesper reports hull stress beyond tolerance.
A pale shape presses the porthole and the scientists force the bulkhead wheel closed.

s02024.summary: The Halloran family jokes in the greenhouse as Toby digs with a trowel.
Toby's trowel hits metal and Rosalind sternly orders him to stop digging.
Rosalind opens a buried tin of letters, watch and baby shoe from forty years ago.
Desmond shouts that she lied about his father, and she shouts back.
The ticking watch softens everyone and Rosalind lets Toby hold it.
The family breaks into helpless laughter, and Rosalind returns to planting tomatoes.

s02309.summary: The crew finds Container Seventeen sealed from within with a body-warm heat signature.
The stowaway begs them not to open it as the seal weakens.
The container bursts open, revealing a figure with the boy's face.

s01538.summary: Neely and Lucy share coffee on a truck hood and talk about his father.
Lucy says she leaves Friday; Neely can only say he knows, and their hands touch.
Headlights stop and security guard Old Barn appears.
Old Barn says Neely's late father left a reel in the booth, and they go to the projector.

s00859.summary: With the seal failing in minutes, Okonjo orders Ravi to reroute power.
Surface urges ascent; Okonjo refuses as the hull groans and a rivet pops.
Ravi's repair works, the pressure normalizes and the crew exhales in relief.

s01955_1.summary: Six strangers wait in a stalled gondola, each coping in their own way.
They compare how long it has been; Nkechi coaxes pale Dariusz to drink water.
The cabin lurches and finally begins to move.

s02350.summary: Three passengers freeze in a stranded cable car since the previous night.
Pauline offers matches and Hannelore her newspaper; they burn it for warmth together.
The cable jolts and Hannelore recognizes the generator sound as rescuers trying.

s02153.summary: Dominic sues baker Petra over a collapsed wedding cake; she blames his uncle's dive.
The judge rules for Petra and wryly recommends she keep the flash drive.

s01214.summary: Lavinia tells Desmond he is being reallocated, not fired, to the bell tower.
Desmond learns he is the whole quality team, then announces his promotion to the room.
He climbs to the tower; Lavinia watches, and a bell rings.

s02502.summary: Leilani hauls on the rope as Cormac dangles thirty feet below in a crevasse.
The axe slips; Cormac finds a foothold and Leilani urges him to climb.

s02508.summary: Siblings bicker over their late mother's old cake after the funeral.
Emeka snaps that she slices the cake while their mother was buried hours ago.
Emeka admits he never said goodbye and Bronagh tells him their mother squeezed her hand.
Bronagh cuts the cake into three pieces and serves each sibling.

s01841.summary: Two detectives and the owner gather around bookkeeper Miriam in her office.
Ruth drifts about, Enzo locks the door, and they demand the second ledger.
Miriam denies a second ledger, sweating onto the page.

s00366.summary: Salesman Duane pitches memory foam to a couple testing mattresses.
Theo sinks into foam and cannot get up; Duane and Lucinda pull him and all tumble.

s00402.summary: The lawyer reads Uncle Teodoro's will, leaving the fish to Lola.
The final line leaves the land and trailer to neighbor Wanjiru, who stayed.
Ezekiel hurls magazines, kicks a box, and scuffles with Darius against the fish tank.
Calm Wanjiru says Teodoro foresaw this and shows a brass key.

s01183.summary: Lt. Finch watches Oskar and his briefcase while Spud sings karaoke.
Finch draws and chases Oskar, who hurls the briefcase, spilling shoe coupons.
Both freeze at the coupons, Spud cheers and Beth demands payment.

s00169.summary: The family squabbles over the late father's boat at the funeral meal.
Zainab produces the will written on a napkin: give the boat to whoever sails it.
Thaddeus says quietly that he knows how, and everyone falls silent.

s01581.summary: Weary staff trade sarcasm as Branden runs a Friday pulse check.
Holloway raises layoff rumors and Priyanka presses Branden, who deflects.
Holloway ends the call early and Branden erases the whiteboard.

s00238.summary: Six teens hesitate atop the ten-meter platform, nobody wanting to go first.
Sunita stops the twins, saying after this it is September.
Pete sits and the others gather on the edge; the twins then jump.

s02452.summary: Coach Basil readies rivals Dmitri and Hector for a winner-to-State match.
They wrestle fiercely; Hector scores first and Dmitri spits in frustration.
Dmitri nearly pins Hector, who explodes, rolls, and pins him instead.
Dmitri accepts Hector's hand and tells him to take it to State.

s01611.summary: Two lawyers spar over a right of way before Judge Florence.
Florence silences both, seats them, and rules from the bench: affirmed.

s00753.summary: At the altar the officiant asks for objections and the hungover best man speaks up.
A DJ's voice blares over the PA, bass thumps, and the organ turns to a remix.

s02476.summary: Purser Holloway drags a soot-faced stowaway before the captain.
The cap falls revealing a woman, Clementine, who demands passage to New York.
She explains her father thinks she is dead, and Captain Vane orders tea and a blanket.
Vane brushes off Holloway's regulations and Clementine laughs.

s01829.summary: Rosalind, her son Elias and lawyer Noel wait outside the courtroom.
Rosalind urges Elias to eat; Noel says Elias must read his statement aloud.
Elias goes to the window and Rosalind begins reading the statement with him.
